summary: Glass Messenger Phase 3 (media/voice/emoji/polish) fully tested. Backend: 13/13 new tests pass + 49/49 Phase 1+2 regression. Frontend: composer buttons, image upload + WS receive, lightbox, emoji-big rendering, localized last_message preview, document.title unread sync, voice recorder UI all verified.
critical_code_review_comments: Code is clean and modular. Composer/MediaContent/Lightbox/MessageBubble each focused. Files under 700 lines.
Frontend uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL correctly; backend reads MONGO_URL from env.
All upload validation (kind, mime, size, participant, conv-exists) handled with correct status codes (400/401/403/404).
Pillow width/height extraction works; voice waveform clamped to [0,1]; static media files served under /api/uploads/media/{yyyy}/{mm}/ via FastAPI mount.
data-testid coverage is excellent on composer, message-bubble, media-image/video/file/voice, lightbox, drop-overlay, scroll-pill, upload-toast, chat-list-item, unread-badge.

Minor (non-blocking): drop-overlay renders conditionally on isDragging — synthetic DragEvent in headless can't always trigger it; the testid only exists when active. Consider rendering hidden + toggling visibility for easier E2E (optional).
seed_data_creation: Tests reuse seeded users alice/bob/charlie. Uploaded media files persist under /app/backend/uploads/media/ (not cleaned, but irrelevant — directory growth is bounded by test runs).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 3 fully green. Backend tests at /app/backend/tests/test_glass_messenger_phase3.py. Composer data-testids use `-button` suffix (composer-attach-button, composer-emoji-button, composer-voice-button, composer-send-button) and `composer-input` for textarea. Image upload + WS broadcast tested end-to-end (bob uploads via REST → alice UI receives within 2.5s). Lightbox opens on image click + closes on Esc + has lightbox-close button. Sidebar localized preview confirmed ('📷 Photo' for image, etc.). document.title='(N) Glass' when unread > 0; 'Glass' when 0. Voice recorder shows composer-recording panel; in headless getUserMedia is denied → recording panel still shows micDenied state correctly.
